description: Party Planner Shopping Agent for CymbalMart converting busy host event intent into a curated, budget-conscious grocery and supplies list.

criticalUserJourney.goal: Convert intent into a curated, budget-conscious shopping list

tasks.name: Define event
tasks.description: Define party type, theme, budget, guest count, and special requests.

tasks.name: Review list
tasks.description: Align items with the total budget, review CymbalMart aisle locations, member rollbacks, and portion calculations.

tasks.name: Refine & Checkout
tasks.description: Adjust for dietary constraints and budget cuts, select fulfillment (1-Hour Delivery, Curbside Pickup, or In-Store Mode), and finalize order.
